Sri Lankan Javelin Thrower's Equipment Damaged Ahead of Asian Games

Sri Lankan javelin thrower Rumesh Tharanga's equipment has been damaged. His record-breaking javelins were reportedly broken during transit ahead of the Asian Games. Tharanga, a national champion, has returned to Sri Lanka to a reception described as 'broken'. The extent of the damage and its impact on his participation in the upcoming games are not specified in the coverage.
